'''Antoni "Toni" Bernadó Planas'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Bernadó|Planas}} (born 9 December 1966) is an Andorran long-distance runner who finished 87th in [[Athletics at the 1996 Summer Olympics – Men's marathon|Men's marathon at the 1996 Summer Olympics]], 49th at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]], 57th at the [[2004 Summer Olympics]], 58th at the [[2008 Summer Olympics]] and 74th at the [[2012 Summer Olympics]].<ref>{{World Athletics||Antoni BERNADÓ}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/be/toni-bernado-1.html |title=Toni Bernadó |quote=Full name: Antonio Bernadó Planas |access-date=2021-05-12 |archive-date=2011-08-23 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110823124037/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/be/toni-bernado-1.html |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Olympedia – Toni Bernadó |url=https://www.olympedia.org/athletes/64314 |access-date=2025-05-24 |website=www.olympedia.org}}</ref> He is the first and so far only athlete to have finished five Olympic Marathons.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.ara.cat/especials/londres2012/Toni-Bernado-converteix-maratons-olimpiques_0_754124716.html |title=L'andorrà Toni Bernadó es converteix en el primer atleta que acaba cinc maratons olímpiques |publisher=ara.cat |date=2012-08-12 |accessdate=2012-08-13 |language=Catalan}}</ref> He held the [[Masters M40 3000 metres world record progression|Masters M40 3000 metres world record]] for three years.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.arrs.run/Veterans/VR1_O3K.htm |title=Порно видео онлайн бесплатно |website=Arrs.net |accessdate=26 November 2018}}</ref>

==Personal bests==
*3000 metres – 8:03.69 (Palafrugell 2007)
*5000 metres – 14:10.06 (Mataró 2005)
*10,000 metres – 29:47.74 (Vic 2002)
*Half marathon – 1:05:24 (Barcelona 2005)
*Marathon – 2:14:25 (Barcelona 2003)
